role.altitude: Today the three bookkeepers spend most of their reporting, budget and tax time exporting from AFAS, rebuilding Excel sheets and checking totals by hand. Afterwards they maintain the report definitions, mapping tables and VAT checks. They decide which exceptions reach the controller and when a dataset is complete enough to release.
reach: Accountant: month-close journal checks and accruals, so they learn how AP/AR cut-off affects the close
FP&A Analyst: forecast drivers, so they learn which budget lines move with flex-worker volume and season
Credit and Collections Officer: DSO and dunning, so they learn which AR reports actually change customer behaviour
Payroll Specialist: wage-tax and pension filings, so they learn where agency and payroll costs meet in the ledger
skills_to_grow: Maintaining mapping tables (GL account to report line, cost centre to site) on a governed data platform
Reading Power BI datasets and AFAS GetConnector outputs well enough to spot a broken feed
Dutch VAT edge cases: reverse charge, intra-EU purchases, ICP, and the e-invoice reporting duties expected later
Chain-liability (inlenersaansprakelijkheid) evidence for the three staffing agencies
Writing short variance explanations that a controller can sign off
role.ambitious_version: The bookkeeping team runs a weekly AP/AR and cash pack plus a continuous VAT and chain-liability check from AFAS data. The controller gets a close-ready file on working day 2 instead of having to build one. The team is also ready for the e-invoice reporting duties expected from 2030 and 2031.

tasks.short: Build AP/AR, cash, expense and P&L reports and tables from AFAS for the controller and finance director.

steps.what: Export aging lists, open items, bank and ledger data from AFAS
Rework exports in Excel: pivots, site and cost-centre mapping, tables
Check report totals against trial balance and bank balances
Write short notes on large or unusual items

loop.input: Variance table with the top movements per ledger account, supplier and customer, plus prior-month notes
loop.output: Two to five draft sentences per flagged movement, each citing the figures it uses
loop.check: Every number in the draft is matched by code against the variance table; drafts with unmatched figures are dropped
loop.stop: One pass per flagged line, at most two retries; on failure the line shows 'no draft' for the bookkeeper to write
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cover the figures but not the reason, which sits in free-text invoice lines and booking descriptions

steps.what: Mail the report pack to controller and finance director

tasks.design: Replace the monthly AFAS exports and Excel rework with Power BI reports on the existing nightly AFAS extract. Add a governed mapping table (ledger account to report line, cost centre to site) and a scheduled reconciliation check against the trial balance and bank balances. A bounded model step drafts notes on the flagged variances for the bookkeeper to edit, and a Power BI subscription replaces the mail round.
tasks.previous_blocker: The nightly AFAS extract fed HR and finance dashboards but not the AP/AR detail, and the site and cost-centre mapping lived only in personal Excel files.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes Power BI models, mapping tables and reconciliation scripts cheap to build. AFAS already exposes the data through GetConnectors, and a small model can draft variance notes against fixed figures.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping the mapping table right when ledger accounts or cost centres change, and explaining variances that depend on facts outside AFAS, such as a disputed agency invoice.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which supplier dispute, agency correction or late customer payment is behind a number, and deciding what the controller needs to hear about it.

ambition.what: A weekly AP/AR and cash pack instead of a monthly one, so the controller can act on overdue items and cash dips during the month.

tasks.altitude: The bookkeeper stops building reports and spends about an hour a week reviewing exceptions and notes. They decide when a report is released and which items reach the controller.

reach.task: Month-close review and trial balance sign-off
reach.learn: Which report lines the controller challenges, so the checks catch them first
Which AR aging cuts help collections prioritise customers

evidence.claim: AFAS bank matching is rule-based, on payment reference, IBAN and invoice number, with misses going to a person
Power BI can schedule refreshes and mail subscriptions on an existing dataset
Vendor guidance says to log every decision with its data and let people handle exceptions

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract can be extended with open-item and ledger detail
Report layouts are stable from month to month
Variance notes go to internal readers only, not to auditors without review
unknowns: Which reports are produced today, for whom, and how often
Whether the AFAS extract runs on a platform finance may change
Who owns the cost-centre mapping today
research_questions: How many hours a month do the three bookkeepers spend on exports and Excel rework, measured over one close?
Can the existing AFAS extract deliver open items and ledger lines at transaction level without slowing the nightly run?
Would the controller accept drafted variance notes after one month of side-by-side comparison?

tasks.short: Collect actuals, previous budgets and budget-holder estimates into the yearly and quarterly budget files for FP&A.

steps.what: Pull prior-year actuals and current budget per cost centre from AFAS
Send templates to budget holders and chase their estimates by mail
Consolidate estimates into budget workbook mapped to ledger accounts
Check large changes against last year and flag gaps

loop.input: Lines that change more than a set threshold against last year, plus the budget holder's free-text explanation
loop.output: A flag per line: explained, unclear or missing, with one sentence saying why
loop.check: Thresholds are set in code; the model only labels lines code has already selected, and the bookkeeper sees every 'unclear' or 'missing' line
loop.stop: One pass per flagged line; if the model gives no answer, the line is labelled 'unclear'
loop.why_not_simpler: Whether a free-text reason such as 'extra Venlo shift in Q4' covers the change needs reading, not a rule

steps.what: Hand the file to FP&A and load the approved budget into AFAS

tasks.design: A small budget-input app on the governed data platform (or a locked SharePoint list with Power Automate) gives each budget holder a pre-filled form with last year's AFAS actuals per cost centre. It sends reminders and writes straight into one consolidated table mapped to ledger accounts. Code flags large changes, a bounded model step labels whether the holder's explanation covers them, and after FP&A approval a script loads the budget into AFAS.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget holders work in their own Excel copies and mailboxes. Consolidation needed a person who knew the mapping and could chase late senders.
tasks.enabler_now: Low-cost CRUD apps and Power Automate flows are quick to build with AI-assisted coding. AFAS accepts budget imports, and a small model can sort free-text explanations at low cost.
tasks.still_hard: Budget holders who skip the form or change structure mid-cycle, and seasonal flex-worker volume that nobody can estimate well.
tasks.human_edge: Pushing back on a site manager's estimate that does not fit last year's run rate, and knowing which estimates FP&A will trust.

ambition.what: A quarterly budget re-estimate by budget holders instead of only a yearly round, because collection and consolidation cost little.

tasks.altitude: The bookkeeper stops copying and chasing. They spend their time on the flagged lines and decide which ones go back to the budget holder before FP&A sees the file.

reach.learn: Which drivers, such as flex hours or pallets moved, FP&A uses, so the budget form can ask for them

reach.task: Budget versus actuals review in the close
reach.learn: Which cost-centre splits make variances readable

evidence.claim: Coding suggestions from history still need people to review and confirm for accountability
AFAS Profit supports importing budgets per ledger account and cost centre
SharePoint lists with Power Automate can collect structured input and send reminders

assumptions: Budget holders are site and department managers with Microsoft 365 accounts
The budget is held per ledger account and cost centre in AFAS
FP&A, not the bookkeeper, approves the final numbers
unknowns: How many budget holders there are and how many cost centres per site
Whether the budget is loaded into AFAS today or only kept in Excel
Which part of budget work the bookkeepers do versus FP&A
research_questions: How many days of the last budget round went to chasing and consolidating versus checking?
Would budget holders fill a pre-filled form, tested with three managers from different sites?
Does FP&A want driver inputs, such as flex hours, in the same form, or would that slow the round?

tasks.short: Prepare and file VAT and ICP returns and keep chain-liability evidence for staffing agencies.

steps.what: Run VAT report in AFAS and reconcile VAT accounts to ledger
Check reverse-charge, intra-EU and odd VAT codes on invoices

loop.input: Invoices whose VAT code breaks a code rule (EU supplier with domestic VAT, zero VAT without a reverse-charge note, and so on), with the invoice text
loop.output: A suggested VAT treatment and the invoice phrase it is based on
loop.check: Code rules pick the invoices; the suggestion must quote text present on the invoice; the bookkeeper accepts or corrects each one
loop.stop: One pass per invoice, at most two retries; otherwise marked 'manual'
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules find suspect lines, but the reason, such as a service versus goods supply, sits in free-text invoice descriptions

steps.what: Fill and submit VAT and ICP returns to the Belastingdienst
Collect agency payment-behaviour statements and check g-rekening payments
File returns and evidence; answer auditor and tax office questions

tasks.design: A scheduled job on the governed data platform reads AFAS ledger and invoice data each week. It reconciles VAT accounts, flags rule breaks, tracks each agency's payment-behaviour statement expiry and g-rekening split, and feeds a Power BI tax dashboard. A bounded model step suggests VAT treatment for flagged invoices. The return is still submitted from AFAS by the bookkeeper after the controller approves, and a dossier per period is built automatically in SharePoint.
tasks.previous_blocker: VAT checks were done once per period by eye, and chain-liability evidence sat in mailboxes with no expiry tracking.
tasks.enabler_now: Rule checks on AFAS data and expiry tracking are cheap to build with AI-assisted coding. A small model can read invoice text to explain a suspect VAT code without making the decision.
tasks.still_hard: Edge cases in VAT treatment that need a tax adviser, and the e-invoice reporting duties expected from 2030 and 2031, whose final form is not law yet.
tasks.human_edge: Signing off a return that is filed with the Belastingdienst and cannot be undone without a correction, and judging unclear VAT cases with the controller or tax adviser.

ambition.what: A continuous chain-liability check for the three staffing agencies, warning before a payment-behaviour statement expires or a g-rekening share is missed.

tasks.altitude: The bookkeeper moves from period-end checking to a weekly review of a short exception list. They decide which VAT cases go to the controller or tax adviser before filing.

reach.learn: How agency costs and own payroll costs are split, so chain-liability risk is not counted twice

reach.task: Tax position in the month close
reach.learn: Which VAT corrections the auditor raised before, so the checks target them

evidence.claim: Noordhaven can be liable for agencies' unpaid wage tax and VAT and limits this with a payment-behaviour statement, good records and g-rekening payments
B2B e-invoicing is planned from 1 July 2030 with reporting from 1 July 2031, not law yet
On one reading, buyers must report intra-EU and reverse-charge purchases within 5 days of receipt under the coming rules
Own ledger accounts, VAT codes and exceptions per administration block fully automatic processing
AFAS Profit can submit VAT and ICP returns electronically

assumptions: VAT returns are filed monthly or quarterly from AFAS by the bookkeepers
Wage-tax and pension filings stay with payroll
Noordhaven has some intra-EU suppliers or customers near the Venlo border
unknowns: Filing frequency and whether a tax adviser reviews returns
Whether all three agencies already use g-rekening payments and how the split is booked
How VAT corrections were found in past audits
research_questions: How many VAT corrections were made in the last two years, and would code rules have caught them?
Are agency payment-behaviour statements up to date for all three agencies today?
Does the AFAS VAT report give invoice-level detail with VAT codes for every administration?
